+++ b/demo-iac/vm-deployment.tf (policy & quota compliant)
@@ -8,11 +8,12 @@ resource "azurerm_linux_virtual_machine" "workload_vm" {
   name                = "vm-contoso-workload-01"

     Environment = "Production"
     ManagedBy   = "ContextPane-GitOps"
   }
 }
